data_contract.source: verified Exness DEMO bid/ask tick CSV
data_contract.feature_availability: A feature window is available only after its end timestamp. No partial or current unfinished window may trigger a signal.
data_contract.permitted_history: Current and prior completed windows only; all rolling statistics must be computed from strictly preceding observations.

known_development_data.permitted_use: Feature and simulator development smoke tests only.
known_development_data.note: These two short sessions have already been inspected and are not eligible as an untouched final holdout.

evaluation.signal_entry: First valid quote strictly after the completed signal window end.
evaluation.exit_quote: First valid quote at or after entry_time + horizon, provided it is no more than 2 seconds late; otherwise outcome is missing.

executable_quote_convention.spread_treatment: Included once through executable bid/ask crossing; do not subtract spread a second time.

additional_costs.slippage_values: Sensitivity assumptions only, not measured slippage.
additional_costs.pass_rule: No net-performance claim or candidate pass is allowed until commission is verified from the applicable Exness account schedule or statements.

quote_and_data_invalidation: Reject any non-XAUUSD contract or unverified broker-symbol mapping.
Reject malformed, non-finite, crossed, or non-positive bid/ask quotes.
Reject a signal if the completed feature window or required trailing history is missing.
Reject entry if no valid quote arrives within 5 seconds after signal-window completion.
Reject outcome if no valid quote arrives within 2 seconds after the target exit horizon.
Never forward-fill a quote or use a later quote to revise an earlier decision.
evaluation.primary_outcome: Executable quote-crossed gross price change in XAUUSD price units, followed by explicit commission and slippage sensitivity; report gross and net separately.
evaluation.evaluation_is_not_execution: All fills are theoretical quote-crossed marks. No broker order is sent and no actual fill probability is inferred.

candidates.falsifiable_hypothesis: After a completed short-horizon directional impulse, the next 5–60 seconds exhibit positive continuation often enough to overcome the contemporaneous bid/ask spread and verified additional costs.
candidates.signal_definition: Direction is the sign of the trailing mid-price log return over the selected lookback. Trigger only when absolute return divided by a strictly prior realized-volatility scale meets the registered threshold.
candidates.direction: Long for positive impulse; short for negative impulse.
candidates.invalidation: No entry when required prior windows are incomplete, volatility scale is zero or unavailable, or quote/data invalidation rules fail.
candidates.exit: Fixed holding horizon; no adaptive exit or stop is introduced in this preregistered first test.
candidates.primary_failure_condition: After executable bid/ask crossing and verified costs, forward outcomes are not positive or do not outperform the no-signal and directional benchmarks.

candidates.falsifiable_hypothesis: A sufficiently large short-term mid-price displacement from a trailing reference mean is followed by a reversal over 5–60 seconds that exceeds spread and verified additional costs.
candidates.signal_definition: Compute displacement from a rolling mean using only completed prior 5-second mid-price observations; standardize by a trailing realized-volatility scale. Trigger when absolute standardized displacement meets the registered threshold.
candidates.direction: Short above the trailing reference mean; long below it.
candidates.invalidation: No entry when required prior windows are incomplete, volatility scale is zero or unavailable, or quote/data invalidation rules fail.
candidates.exit: Fixed holding horizon; no adaptive exit or stop is introduced in this preregistered first test.
candidates.primary_failure_condition: Reversal outcomes do not survive executable bid/ask crossing and verified additional costs, or do not outperform the registered benchmarks.

candidates.falsifiable_hypothesis: A completed low-range consolidation followed by a directional break of the preceding range has positive 5–60 second continuation after spread and verified costs.
candidates.signal_definition: Define the prior range from strictly preceding completed windows. A signal occurs only when the current completed window closes beyond that prior range by the registered fraction of a trailing volatility scale, and the prior range qualifies as compressed under the frozen trailing comparison rule.
candidates.direction: Long above the prior range high; short below the prior range low.
candidates.invalidation: No entry when the compression history is incomplete, the volatility scale is unavailable, the breakout is not confirmed by a completed window, or quote/data invalidation rules fail.
candidates.exit: Fixed holding horizon; no adaptive exit or stop is introduced in this preregistered first test.
candidates.primary_failure_condition: Breakout continuation does not persist after executable bid/ask crossing and verified costs, or fails against registered benchmarks.

data_partition_policy.development_data: Previously inspected Sessions 8 and 9 may be used only for implementation smoke tests and simulator debugging.
data_partition_policy.validation_data: Must be chronologically later than development data and must not be used to revise the registered candidate definitions after results are viewed.
data_partition_policy.final_holdout: An untouched final holdout must consist of independent, previously unseen collection sessions on later dates; do not open or score it until implementation and validation choices are frozen.
leakage_controls: No future-window or centered rolling calculations.
No overlapping labels across train/validation/holdout boundaries.
Purge at least the maximum 60-second outcome horizon plus the maximum 60-second signal lookback at each partition boundary.
All normalization and percentile thresholds are fitted only on the preceding training partition.

limitations: The two inspected development sessions cover only about one hour on one date and cannot establish market-wide behaviour.
The observed median spread is 240 broker points, equal to 0.240 XAUUSD price units at point size 0.001.
Tick counts are not traded volume; order-book depth and actual fills are unavailable.
Commission and slippage are not yet independently verified.
This registry is a falsifiable research plan, not evidence of an edge or a trading recommendation.
